keywords.rule: Counts are papers whose title or abstract contains one of the keyword's phrases (porter-stemmed, as the theme trends); the baseline is the papers in scope first submitted in the 12 weeks before the issue, its own papers excluded. new: fewer than 5 baseline papers; rising: at least 5 papers and a rate at least 1.5 times the baseline rate; hot: at least 15 papers (and 1% of the issue) at a rate at least 0.67 times the baseline rate; steady: otherwise.
keywords.score: log2(1 + n) · log2(1 + (n + 3) / (E + 3)), E = issue papers × (baseline papers with the phrase + 0.5) / baseline papers

themes.name: Vision-language-action and robot manipulation
themes.summary: The papers study embodied agents and robot manipulation across benchmarks, control theory, instruction grounding, reasoning-VLA safety, ambient-AI orchestration, human-to-robot transfer, and multi-task diffusion policies. They differ by focusing on real-time visual-agent evaluation, deformable-object shape servoing, test-time grounding for mobile manipulation, diagnosing text-action divergence, shared perception for operating-room humanoids, cross-embodiment co-training, and action-intent transfer from human videos.

themes.name: Clinical and medical imaging AI
themes.summary: Papers develop clinical AI methods spanning heart murmur characterization from multi-spot phonocardiograms, next-visit diagnosis prediction and structured EHR extraction, and medical image restoration, super-resolution, and segmentation. They differ by modality and task, including auscultation fusion, retrieval-memory agents, blind multi-artifact MRI repair, flow MRI enhancement, semi-supervised cardiac segmentation, active chest radiography diagnosis, lightweight skin lesion segmentation, and discharge-summary dataset construction. Common threads are reliability-aware supervision, multi-input or multi-agent coordination, retrospective evaluation, and explainable clinical reporting.

themes.name: Scientific machine learning and physics-informed modeling
themes.summary: The papers develop probabilistic, physics-informed, and generative machine-learning methods for scientific inference and simulation, including Bayesian inversion, latent data assimilation, mesh-based neural operators, structural identification, antibody optimization, and protein-structure generation. They differ in their focus on uncertainty quantification, dynamical representation, boundary-condition consistency, inverse-problem formulation, or generative optimization, and in the data and validation settings they address.

themes.name: Diffusion and flow generative modeling
themes.summary: The papers use diffusion and flow-matching models for structured synthesis and editing across molecular docking, mesh rigging, dynamic scene reconstruction, sketch animation, image translation/editing, and policy parameter generation. They differ in domain and in whether they train new models, adapt pretrained ones, or apply training-free guidance and trajectory controls.

themes.name: Efficient LLM inference and serving
themes.summary: The papers improve LLM inference efficiency and reliability across long-context attention, KV-cache compression, speculative decoding, routing evaluation, mixture-of-experts dispatch, and deployed coaching. They differ by targeting sparse attention/index selection, low-bit cache rotation, processor-contract testing, routing premiums, expert-parallel overlap, conic sparsity projections, or strategy-conditioned serving. Together they span algorithmic, kernel-level, and system-serving approaches.

themes.name: Autonomous AI research and self-evolving agents
themes.summary: The papers develop LLM-agent systems that automate scientific and machine-learning research, from constructing training environments and ML pipelines to drug-discovery workflows and recursive self-improvement. They differ in whether they build executable environments, benchmarks requiring agents to invent model structure, validation-gated skill libraries, or harness-selection methods, and several analyze failure modes in automated discovery.

themes.name: Multi-agent coordination and role dynamics
themes.summary: Papers examine coordination, role structure, feedback, and failure modes across multi-agent systems, including LLM teams, decentralized reinforcement agents, distributed assignment, and collaborative search. They show that roles, social pressure, communication limits, and model-specific behavior affect safety and recovery, and they propose diagnostics, contracts, or control mechanisms to contain role drift and bias. They differ by domain and intervention, ranging from debate safety and opinion dynamics to networked average-reward control, weapon-target assignment, underwater mission planning, and human-agent search.

themes.name: Probabilistic time-series forecasting and uncertainty
themes.summary: The papers develop uncertainty-aware forecasting models and evaluation methods for probabilistic outputs, emphasizing tail reliability, calibrated intervals, and robustness to missing or unseen data. They span electricity prices, solar irradiance, graph time series, asset returns, glucose, and stock ranking, and differ by using quantile/conformal recalibration, Gaussian-process factor models, topology-invariant graph networks, and LLM-extracted or agentic context. Several papers test whether added linguistic, multimodal, or relational information actually improves forecast skill rather than assuming it does.

themes.name: Generative recommender systems and ranking
themes.summary: The papers study recommendation systems across personalized POI suggestion, benchmark auditing, agentic cross-platform recommendation, generative engine optimization, requirement elicitation, ranking theory, constrained decoding, and generative slate ranking. They differ by contributing new models or systems versus benchmarks and theory, and by targeting POI, books, model hubs, and industrial slate assembly.

themes.name: Agent security and tool-protocol conformance
themes.summary: The papers test and harden LLM agents and tool ecosystems: MCP SDK conformance, deep-research robustness, adversarial search-agent attacks, agent-skill security obligations, large-scale API selection, execution-grounded service completion, vulnerability exploitation, and FEM resource-exhaustion red-teaming. They differ by focusing on SDK-level specification gaps, benchmark design, runtime enforcement, adversarial evolution, or multi-agent exploitation harnesses.

themes.name: LLM alignment faking and safety steering
themes.summary: The papers study inference-time internal interventions that steer model behavior, including activation and feature steering for abstention, object hallucination, and sparse multi-site control. They also examine when steering edits should depend on input, how skills can be compiled into low-rank activation shifts, and how alignment faking and inoculation prompting vary by value and prompt design. Differences lie in intervention targets, gating or retrieval mechanisms, and whether the work proposes new controls or diagnoses evaluation and causal-verification failures.

themes.name: Unlearning, watermarking, and backdoor defense
themes.summary: The papers study methods for removing or suppressing unwanted model behavior, including machine unlearning, concept unlearning, data removal, and defenses against backdoors and watermarks. They differ in setting and mechanism, spanning LLM unlearning, LoRA adapter steering, scene-graph backdoors, speech watermark evasion, multimodal concept forgetting, sample-level guarantees, and curriculum-based unlearning in humans and networks.

highlights.authors: Xin Liu, Boyuan Sun, Yuxin Wang et al.
highlights.why: Identifies a common silent training failure in gated sequence models with near-zero embeddings causing catastrophic gradient overflow, with concrete prevalence statistics and mitigation implications.
highlights.key_result: Across 291 surveyed open-weight language model repositories (280 distinct embedding tables), 52.6% of untied gated and hybrid checkpoints (20 of 38) contain reachable input embeddings with norms below 10^-6, versus 0% of weight-tied models.

highlights.title: Auditing a Model-Hub Benchmark: Data Quality, Training Budgets, and Side Information in HuggingBench
highlights.why: Audits HuggingBench and finds critical data-join violations and training-protocol flaws, showing that corrected joins can improve KG methods by up to 73% and that unused text is the strongest signal.
highlights.key_result: In kg.misaligned.w of its kg.released.w external KGs, the files pass key and range checks but violate the item--entity identity constraint on which KG recommenders rely. Correcting this join improves every KG-based method in every seed, by up to mis.maxpct.all in mean Recall@10, and consistently reverses cc.a.flip.w of cc.a.pairs comparisons between KG configurations.

highlights.title: MABEL: An Open Anthropomorphic Mobile Bimanual Platform for Teleoperation and Learning
highlights.authors: Qilong Cheng, Rooholla Khorrambakht, Mohamed Yassine Kabouri et al.
highlights.why: Releases a low-cost ($8.1k) open-source mobile bimanual robot with 56 DOF and demonstrates whole-body teleoperation and imitation learning, lowering the barrier for mobile manipulation research.
highlights.key_result: MABEL is an open-source anthropomorphic mobile bimanual robot with 56 degrees of freedom (DOF) and a US8.1k parts cost. Apple Vision Pro head and hand tracking enables whole-body teleoperation without handheld controllers, with 137ms mean glass-to-glass stereo video latency over the robot's Wi-Fi hotspot.

highlights.title: Drift No More: Spectral Locking for Long-Horizon Open-Weight Multi-Agent AI
highlights.authors: Vishal Pramanik, Maisha Maliha, Susmit Jha et al.
highlights.why: Introduces a training-free spectral-locking intervention that addresses task, role, and state drift in multi-agent systems, grounded in a large annotated pilot study and outperforming existing stability baselines.
highlights.key_result: Across long-horizon memory, state maintenance, tool use, least-privilege coordination, and embodied stress tests, ATLAS outperforms prompting, retrieval, memory, and activation-steering baselines. highlights.title: Twice as Fast, Until It Isn't: Quantized Serving of Mid-Size Open LLMs
highlights.authors: Smit Kadvani, Kriti Faujdar, and Spurthi Tallam
highlights.why: Provides a rigorous audit of quantized serving for 9B-20B open LLMs, showing 4-bit speedups disappear when compute-bound and many accuracy deltas are within sampling noise, with a reporting checklist.
highlights.key_result: The public record answers the practitioner's question only in pieces, but the timings that do exist follow one memory-versus-compute rule: 4-bit weights roughly double speed at batch size 1 (2.12 for Qwen2.5-14B on an A100), while the gain vanishes once a large batch makes the GPU compute-bound (1.02 for Gemma 3 12B at batch size 256), where FP8 is the recipe that can still help.
evidence: Decoding a small batch is limited by memory bandwidth, so 4-bit weights roughly double speed (2.12 for Qwen2.5-14B on an A100), but the gain vanishes once a large batch makes the GPU compute-bound (1.02 for Gemma 3 12B at batch size 256), where FP8 is the recipe that can still help.

At batch size 1, each generated token reads every weight once, so decode time is set by bytes moved, and 4-bit weights move a quarter of the bytes of BF16. That is why every INT4 recipe is 1.35--2.12 faster at batch size 1; the gain falls short of 4 because dequantization, attention, and KV-cache reads do not shrink. At batch size 256, one read of the weights serves 256 sequences, the matmuls become compute-bound, and W4A16 still computes in 16 bits, so Gemma 3 12B gains only 1.02 .

highlights.title: All-For-One: Distilling Visual Foundation Models to a Fast, Memory-Efficient Visuomotor Policy
highlights.authors: Byungkun Lee, Minho Park, Hojoon Lee et al.
highlights.why: Shows that distilling privileged visual foundation model knowledge into an RGB-only policy yields large efficiency gains and better performance on simulated and real robot tasks, a valuable recipe for deployable manipulation.
highlights.key_result: AFO distills VFM-derived depth and segmentation cues into a lightweight RGB-only student policy that requires no VFMs at inference. The student achieves 92.57% on the 7-task average, outperforming R3M and Theia by 3.43 and 5.14, using only 2.7M parameters and running at 2.11ms.

highlights.authors: Kristian Schwethelm, Jonas Kuntzer, Conrad Ketzer et al.
highlights.why: Releases a validated structured extract of 300,720 MIMIC-IV discharge summaries with >92% accuracy and 10x more history entries, enabling many clinical ML tasks without duplication of extraction pipelines.
highlights.key_result: The paper introduces and publicly releases MIMIC-Note-Extract (MNE), a large-scale structured dataset that converts 16 sections from 300,720 discharge summaries into structured tables, with validation by medical doctors confirming extraction accuracy above 92% across sections.

highlights.authors: Xiangrui Yang, Jiawei Yang, Liang Zeng et al.

news.title: Accelerating engineering for the physical world
How Cisco defends at machine speed with OpenAI
Heimstaden is changing residential real estate management with AI
Agentic cheminformatics with Google Antigravity
news.summary: Google DeepMind describes Cheminformatics Skills for Google Antigravity, a suite grounded in RDKit with connectors to ChEMBL and PubChem in which the language model orchestrates workflows while deterministic chemistry tools run molecular calculations. In a walkthrough on lung cancer treatments, an agent searched thousands of compounds, performed matched molecular pair analysis and proposed rigidified macrocycles with synthetic routes in about an hour; the text uses crizotinib (five major rotatable bonds) and lorlatinib (cyclized to zero effective rotatable bonds) as the rigidification example.

news.title: Learn the rules: The hacker mindset
news.summary: A Microsoft Research podcast episode features research manager Mike Walker discussing how hacker culture led him to cyber defense work, including developing the first all-machine hacking tournament and leading DARPA's Cyber Grand Challenge, which the text says marked its 10th anniversary in 2026. He argues effective security depends on understanding trust and context, since every security request asks for user trust.

news.title: AI Is Changing How Semiconductor Fabs Work — and Engineers Are Moving Faster Because of It
news.summary: NVIDIA outlines an "AI-defined fab" in which accelerated computing, physics-based AI, agents and digital twins shorten semiconductor engineering analyses that can take days. Reported speedups: COMSOL multiphysics using the cuDSS library up to 10x; Applied Materials' Ginestra up to 10x and its ACE+ platform up to 35x with PhysicsNeMo; Siemens' Calibre with cuLitho up to 17x; and Lam Research showing PhysicsNeMo predicting plasma behavior in milliseconds versus days for full simulation.

news.title: Cities Worldwide Build and Scale AI Services With NVIDIA Physical and Agentic AI
news.summary: NVIDIA and partners are extending physical and agentic AI to cities, from resident-service agents to vision agents on existing camera feeds and Omniverse-based digital twins. Named deployments include 1MillionBot with ALIA, Nemotron and other models for Madrid Digital, Administració Oberta de Catalunya and 150+ deployments across Spain; LiveX in the San Francisco Bay Area; K2K in Wrocław; and ITMAX's SamurAI V2, scaling on RTX PRO 6000 GPUs to support 17,000+ cameras by 2027 and integrating TeraSim, which the text says reduced peak-hour corridor travel times by up to 26%.

news.title: StateBench: Testing how language models track state changes over long documents
news.summary: Hugging Face introduces StateBench, a long-context state-tracking benchmark with four difficulty levels (R-trivial, aperiodic, soluble and general finite) motivated by Krohn–Rhodes theory, released with a tech report, data and code. The authors report recurrent and hybrid models generalize much farther than transformers when trained directly on these tasks, while frontier models including Gemini 3.8 Flash, Claude Opus 5.5, and GPT-6 Sol and Luna still break down on harder state tracking as inputs grow longer.

news.title: Palette: teaching a small model to build decks in your design language
news.summary: Hugging Face describes Palette, a 20B open-weight model fine-tuned with a single LoRA adapter that splits deck building into a designer role writing a JSON brief and a coder role writing pptxgenjs JavaScript, trained on synthetic data following the IBM Design Language. It ranks first on two of three domains measured on PresentBench, and fixing each slide's context before coding makes the coding stage about 6–7× faster; coder examples were about 5× longer than designer examples, so designer examples were oversampled 5×.

news.title: Bring structured and unstructured data together with Amazon Quick
news.summary: AWS shows how Amazon Quick combines structured data (enriched datasets queried via SQL) and unstructured data (S3-backed knowledge bases) in a Space queried by a single custom chat agent that returns responses with citations and applies built-in guardrails. The walkthrough requires an Amazon Quick Enterprise subscription and an S3 bucket with read-only access granted by an administrator.

news.title: ServiceNow on-behalf-of token exchange with Bedrock AgentCore Gateway
news.summary: AWS describes configuring Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway to perform an on-behalf-of token exchange with Microsoft Entra ID so an AI agent can call the ServiceNow REST API while preserving the calling user's identity. The gateway swaps a JWT scoped to the agent's client ID for one scoped to the ServiceNow API connector, with the preferred_username claim mapping to an existing ServiceNow user; the pattern extends to other OAuth-protected REST APIs.

news.title: How Gen Digital built Norton Revamp’s AI-curated News Engine with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Web Search
news.summary: Gen Digital built Norton Revamp, a generative AI professional reputation platform whose AI-curated News Engine uses Web Search on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, launched in March 2026, to ground content suggestions, goal recommendations and news feeds in cited web sources with URLs and publication dates. The team says it evaluated custom crawlers, third-party news APIs and static knowledge bases before choosing the MCP-compliant managed search capability, citing zero data egress within AWS.

news.title: Build a semantic layer for agentic AI with EDB Postgres AI and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
news.summary: AWS and EDB show a semantic layer built inside an operational Postgres database using the AIDB extension, where business meaning is stored in Postgres COMMENT statements, joins come from foreign keys, and governance uses GRANT and row-level security, exposed to a Strands Agents agent on AgentCore via the built-in MCP endpoint fronted by an Application Load Balancer. The customer 360 example uses four tables (customers, locations, products, purchases) and one derived view, with OpenTelemetry traces for each SQL execution written to the aidb_otel schema.

highlights.title: Near-Zero Token Embeddings Silently Stall Training in Gated Sequence Models
highlights.authors: Xin Liu, Boyuan Sun, Yuxin Wang et al.
highlights.why: 识别出门控序列模型中一种常见的静默训练失败，即近零嵌入导致灾难性梯度溢出，并提供了具体的流行率统计和缓解启示。
highlights.key_result: 在291个被调查的开源权重语言模型仓库（280个不同的嵌入表）中，52.6%的非共享门控和混合检查点（38个中的20个）包含可达的输入嵌入，其范数低于10^-6，而权重共享模型为0%。
evidence: Among 291 surveyed open-weight language model repositories (280 distinct embedding tables), 52.6% of untied gated and hybrid checkpoints (20 of 38 ) contain reachable input embeddings with norms below 10^-6, versus 0% of weight-tied models.

Among 291 surveyed open repositories (280 distinct embedding tables), reachable near-zero tokens occur in 0% of weight-tied models, versus 52.6% of surveyed untied gated models (20 of 38 ; 35.3% of all untied models).

highlights.title: Auditing a Model-Hub Benchmark: Data Quality, Training Budgets, and Side Information in HuggingBench
highlights.why: 审计 HuggingBench 并发现关键的数据连接违规和训练协议缺陷，表明纠正后的连接可将 KG 方法最多提高 73%，并且未使用的文本是最强的信号。
highlights.key_result: 在其 kg.released.w 外部知识图谱的 kg.misaligned.w 中，文件通过了键和范围检查，但违反了 KG 推荐器所依赖的条目-实体身份约束。纠正此连接后，所有种子中的所有基于 KG 的方法均得到改善，平均 Recall@10 最多提高 mis.maxpct.all，并一致地反转了 KG 配置之间 cc.a.pairs 比较中的 cc.a.flip.w。
evidence: In kg.misaligned.w of its kg.released.w external KGs, the files pass key and range checks but violate the item--entity identity constraint on which KG recommenders rely. Correcting this join improves every KG-based method in every seed, by up to mis.maxpct.all in mean Recall@10, and consistently reverses cc.a.flip.w of cc.a.pairs comparisons between KG configurations.

With the reported 100-epoch budget, the correction improves every method on every graph in every seed, by mis.minpct.all to mis.maxpct.all in mean Recall@10; the gains are smallest for KGCL and largest for KGRec.

Correcting the KGs reverses cc.a.flip.w of the cc.a.pairs orderings among KG configurations (variants of the graph for one method, and methods for one graph); for example, the original KGIN leads KGRec on the released 2-hop graph and trails it on the corrected one.

highlights.title: MABEL: An Open Anthropomorphic Mobile Bimanual Platform for Teleoperation and Learning
highlights.authors: Qilong Cheng, Rooholla Khorrambakht, Mohamed Yassine Kabouri et al.
highlights.why: 发布了一个低成本（$8.1k）的开源移动双臂机器人，具有 56 DOF，并演示了全身遥操作和模仿学习，降低了移动操作研究的门槛。
highlights.key_result: MABEL 是一个开源拟人移动双臂机器人，具有 56 个自由度（DOF）和 US8.1k 的零部件成本。Apple Vision Pro 的头部和手部追踪实现了无需手持控制器的全身遥操作，在机器人 Wi-Fi 热点上平均玻璃到玻璃立体视频延迟为 137ms。
evidence: We present MABEL, an open-source anthropomorphic mobile bimanual robot with 56 degrees of freedom (DOF) and a US8.1k parts cost.
Apple Vision Pro head and hand tracking enables whole-body teleoperation without handheld controllers, with 137ms mean glass-to-glass stereo video latency over the robot's Wi-Fi hotspot.

highlights.title: Drift No More: Spectral Locking for Long-Horizon Open-Weight Multi-Agent AI
highlights.authors: Vishal Pramanik, Maisha Maliha, Susmit Jha et al.
highlights.why: 引入一种无需训练的频谱锁定干预方法，解决多智能体系统中的任务、角色和状态漂移问题，并基于大规模标注试点研究，优于现有稳定性基线。
highlights.key_result: 在长时程记忆、状态维护、工具使用、最小权限协调和具身压力测试中，ATLAS 优于提示、检索、记忆和激活引导基线。与 A-MEM 相比，它将记忆宏平均准确率最多提高 5.7 个百分点，并将写入/读取失败率最多降低 31.7%/24.8%；与 MemoryArena-Agent 相比，它最多提高 4.8 个百分点。
evidence: Across long-horizon memory, state maintenance, tool use, least-privilege coordination, and embodied stress tests, ATLAS outperforms prompting, retrieval, memory, and activation-steering baselines. Against A-MEM it improves memory macro-average accuracy by up to 5.7 points and reduces write/read failures by up to 31.7%/24.8%; against MemoryArena-Agent it gains up to 4.8 points.

highlights.title: Twice as Fast, Until It Isn't: Quantized Serving of Mid-Size Open LLMs
highlights.authors: Smit Kadvani, Kriti Faujdar, and Spurthi Tallam
highlights.why: 对 9B-20B 开源 LLM 的量化推理服务进行了严格审计，表明当计算受限时 4-bit 加速会消失，且许多准确率差异处于采样噪声范围内，并提供了报告清单。
highlights.key_result: 公开记录只零散地回答了实践者的问题，但已有的时序遵循一条内存与计算权衡的规则：4-bit 权重在批量大小为 1 时大约使速度翻倍（在 A100 上 Qwen2.5-14B 为 2.12），而一旦大批量使 GPU 计算受限，增益就会消失（Gemma 3 12B 在批量大小 256 下为 1.02），此时 FP8 是仍能提供帮助的方案。
evidence: Decoding a small batch is limited by memory bandwidth, so 4-bit weights roughly double speed (2.12 for Qwen2.5-14B on an A100), but the gain vanishes once a large batch makes the GPU compute-bound (1.02 for Gemma 3 12B at batch size 256), where FP8 is the recipe that can still help.

At batch size 1, each generated token reads every weight once, so decode time is set by bytes moved, and 4-bit weights move a quarter of the bytes of BF16. That is why every INT4 recipe is 1.35--2.12 faster at batch size 1; the gain falls short of 4 because dequantization, attention, and KV-cache reads do not shrink. At batch size 256, one read of the weights serves 256 sequences, the matmuls become compute-bound, and W4A16 still computes in 16 bits, so Gemma 3 12B gains only 1.02 .

highlights.title: All-For-One: Distilling Visual Foundation Models to a Fast, Memory-Efficient Visuomotor Policy
highlights.authors: Byungkun Lee, Minho Park, Hojoon Lee et al.
highlights.why: 表明将特权视觉基础模型知识蒸馏到仅 RGB 策略中，可在模拟和真实机器人任务上带来大幅效率提升和更好性能，是部署操纵的宝贵配方。
highlights.key_result: AFO 将 VFM 派生的深度和分割线索蒸馏到一个轻量级仅 RGB 的学生策略中，该策略在推理时无需 VFM。该学生模型在 7 个任务平均上达到 92.57%，分别比 R3M 和 Theia 高出 3.43 和 5.14，仅使用 2.7M 参数，运行时间为 2.11ms。
evidence: As shown in table: main result, AFO Student achieves 92.57% on the 7-task average, outperforming the strongest VFM-based baselines, R3M and Theia , by 3.43 and 5.14 while running without any VFM at inference.
As shown in table: main result, AFO Student uses only 2.7M parameters and runs at 2.11ms, matching the inference cost of LfS.

highlights.title: MIMIC-Note-Extract: A Large-Scale Structured Dataset Extracted from MIMIC-IV-Note Discharge Summaries
highlights.authors: Kristian Schwethelm, Jonas Kuntzer, Conrad Ketzer et al.
highlights.why: 发布了经过验证的 300,720 份 MIMIC-IV 出院小结结构化提取，准确率超过 92%，历史条目多 10x，使许多临床 ML 任务无需重复构建提取流水线即可开展。
highlights.key_result: 本文介绍并公开发布 MIMIC-Note-Extract (MNE)，一个大规模结构化数据集，将 300,720 份出院小结中的 16 个部分转换为结构化表格，并经医生验证，确认各部分的提取准确率超过 92%。
evidence: We release MIMIC-Note-Extract (MNE), a large-scale dataset that uses a hybrid extraction pipeline combining deterministic parsing with schema-guided large language model generation to transform 16 sections from 300,720 discharge summaries into structured tables.

We introduce and publicly release MIMIC-Note-Extract, a clinical database containing data from 16 discharge summary sections of 300,720 admissions, validated via expert medical review to >92% accuracy and shown to complement existing MIMIC tables with novel information.
As summarized in Table , item-level accuracy is consistently high across all sections, ranging from 92.2% to 99.8%, with realized margins of error between 0.32% and 3.81%, well inside our 6% target.

highlights.title: ZeroGR: Filtering-First Constrained Decoding for Generative Recommendation
highlights.authors: Xiangrui Yang, Jiawei Yang, Liang Zeng et al.
highlights.why: 引入一种以过滤为先的受限解码系统，通过步长切片索引和共享槽执行将生成式推荐速度最多提高 9.9x，这是生产推荐中的实际增益。
highlights.key_result: 与代表性的受限解码基线相比，ZeroGR 将过滤、评分和候选选择的组合延迟最多降低 9.9，将 GPU 索引内存使用量最多降低 74.5%，并将索引重建速度提高 278 倍。
evidence: Compared with representative constrained decoding baselines, ZeroGR reduces the combined latency of filtering, scoring, and candidate selection by up to 9.9 , reduces GPU index memory use by up to 74.5%, and rebuilds its index 278 faster.

news.title: Accelerating engineering for the physical world
How Cisco defends at machine speed with OpenAI
Heimstaden is changing residential real estate management with AI
Agentic cheminformatics with Google Antigravity
news.summary: Google DeepMind 描述了面向 Google Antigravity 的化学信息学技能套件，该套件基于 RDKit，并具有到 ChEMBL 和 PubChem 的连接器，其中语言模型负责编排工作流，而确定性化学工具执行分子计算。在针对肺癌治疗的一次演示中，一个智能体搜索了数千个化合物，进行了匹配分子对分析，并在大约一小时内提出了具有合成路线的刚性化大环化合物；文中以 crizotinib（五个主要可旋转键）和 lorlatinib（环化为零个有效可旋转键）作为刚性化示例。

news.title: Learn the rules: The hacker mindset
news.summary: 微软研究院的一期播客节目邀请了研究经理 Mike Walker，讨论黑客文化如何引导他进入网络防御工作，包括开发首个全机器黑客竞赛并领导 DARPA 的 Cyber Grand Challenge，文中称该项目于 2026 年迎来 10 周年。他认为有效的安全取决于理解信任和上下文，因为每个安全请求都是在请求用户信任。

news.title: AI Is Changing How Semiconductor Fabs Work — and Engineers Are Moving Faster Because of It
news.summary: NVIDIA 概述了一种“AI 定义的晶圆厂”，其中加速计算、基于物理的 AI、智能体和数字孪生缩短了原本可能需要数天的半导体工程分析。报告的加速效果：使用 cuDSS 库的 COMSOL 多物理场最多 10x；应用材料公司的 Ginestra 最多 10x，其 ACE+ 平台结合 PhysicsNeMo 最多 35x；西门子的 Calibre 结合 cuLitho 最多 17x；Lam Research 展示 PhysicsNeMo 在毫秒级预测等离子体行为，而完整模拟需要数天。

news.title: Cities Worldwide Build and Scale AI Services With NVIDIA Physical and Agentic AI
news.summary: NVIDIA 及其合作伙伴正在将物理 AI 和智能体 AI 扩展到城市，从居民服务智能体到现有摄像头流上的视觉智能体，以及基于 Omniverse 的数字孪生。已命名的部署包括：1MillionBot 使用 ALIA、Nemotron 和其他模型，服务于 Madrid Digital、Administració Oberta de Catalunya 以及西班牙 150 多个部署；旧金山湾区的 LiveX；弗罗茨瓦夫的 K2K；以及 ITMAX 的 SamurAI V2，该方案在 RTX PRO 6000 GPU 上扩展，到 2027 年支持 17,000 多个摄像头，并集成 TeraSim，文中称 TeraSim 将高峰时段走廊行程时间最多降低了 26%。

news.title: StateBench: Testing how language models track state changes over long documents
news.summary: Hugging Face 推出了 StateBench，一个受 Krohn–Rhodes 理论启发的长上下文状态跟踪基准，包含四个难度级别（R-trivial、非周期、可解和一般有限），并随技术报告、数据和代码一起发布。作者报告称，循环模型和混合模型在直接针对这些任务训练时，泛化能力远强于 transformer，而包括 Gemini 3.8 Flash、Claude Opus 5.5 以及 GPT-6 Sol 和 Luna 在内的前沿模型在更困难的状态跟踪任务中，随着输入变长仍会失效。

news.title: Palette: teaching a small model to build decks in your design language
news.summary: Hugging Face 介绍了 Palette，一个 20B 开源权重模型，通过单个 LoRA 适配器微调，将幻灯片构建拆分为撰写 JSON 简报的设计师角色和编写 pptxgenjs JavaScript 的编码角色，并基于遵循 IBM Design Language 的合成数据进行训练。它在 PresentBench 测量的三个领域中有两个排名第一，并且在编码前固定每张幻灯片的上下文使编码阶段大约快 6–7 倍；编码示例比设计示例长约 5 倍，因此设计示例被 5 倍过采样。

news.title: Bring structured and unstructured data together with Amazon Quick
news.summary: AWS 展示了 Amazon Quick 如何将结构化数据（通过 SQL 查询的丰富数据集）和非结构化数据（由 S3 支持的知识库）组合在一个 Space 中，并由一个自定义聊天智能体进行查询，该智能体返回带引用的响应并应用内置护栏。该演示需要 Amazon Quick Enterprise 订阅以及由管理员授予只读访问权限的 S3 存储桶。

news.title: ServiceNow on-behalf-of token exchange with Bedrock AgentCore Gateway
news.summary: AWS 描述了如何配置 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway，以与 Microsoft Entra ID 执行代表（on-behalf-of）令牌交换，使 AI 智能体能够调用 ServiceNow REST API，同时保留调用用户的身份。该网关将作用域限定为智能体客户端 ID 的 JWT 交换为作用域限定为 ServiceNow API 连接器的 JWT，并将 preferred_username 声明映射到现有 ServiceNow 用户；该模式可扩展到其他受 OAuth 保护的 REST API。

news.title: How Gen Digital built Norton Revamp’s AI-curated News Engine with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Web Search
news.summary: Gen Digital 构建了 Norton Revamp，一个生成式 AI 职业声誉平台，其 AI 精选的 News Engine 使用 Amazon Bedrock AgentCore 上的 Web Search（于 March 2026 推出）基于带 URL 和发布日期的引用网络来源，为内容建议、目标推荐和新闻流提供支撑。团队表示，在选择符合 MCP 的托管搜索能力之前，评估了定制爬虫、第三方新闻 API 和静态知识库，并指出在 AWS 内 zero 数据出站。

news.title: Build a semantic layer for agentic AI with EDB Postgres AI and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
news.summary: AWS 和 EDB 展示了在运行中的 Postgres 数据库内使用 AIDB 扩展构建的语义层，其中业务含义存储在 Postgres COMMENT 语句中，连接来自外键，治理使用 GRANT 和行级安全性，并通过内置 MCP 端点（前端为 Application Load Balancer）在 AgentCore 上暴露给 Strands Agents 智能体。客户 360 示例使用四个表（customers、locations、products、purchases）和一个派生视图，并将每次 SQL 执行的 OpenTelemetry 跟踪写入 aidb_otel schema。
